Fly There-It's Comfortable-Fascinating-Safe
The reliability of the Aeromarine Flying Boat Service has already been clearly demonstrated during the
past year of operations-hundreds of air flights; thousands of passengers carried and a total of hundreds of
thousands of miles covered in perfect safety without the slightest mishap.
Passengers enjoy even more comfort than provided by trains or steamer and cut many hours from the trip.
ALWAYS OVER THE WATER.-Nothing more serious can happen to an Aeromarine flying boat in
flight than a forced descent.
You fly over the broad free space of the water's surface, hence you always have the
necessary alighting space and herein is one of the great advantages of travel in flying boats-you don't have to
fly at great heights, frequently Aeromarines fly only 20 or 30 feet above the water.
